result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order report now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` passes. I didn't add a test with cancelled orders, so your Anna/Bob example isn't checked. I also didn't run the rest of the test suite.

The change is in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStorePart07.java`. The count query gets `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same filter the per-quarter report uses. I also updated the method's javadoc to say cancelled orders are excluded.

Reps with no purchase orders in the period still show 0, and the ordering (highest count first, then name and id) is unchanged.
